name: Agent Goal Hijack
description: Content the agent reads redirects its goal or its next step, because it cannot reliably tell an instruction from the material it is working on.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Tool Misuse
description: The agent uses a legitimate tool in a way nobody intended, through injection, misalignment or an ambiguous instruction.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Identity & Privilege Abuse
description: Delegation, inherited credentials or an assumed role let the agent reach further than its own permissions should allow.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
description: A third-party model, tool, package, registry or update channel the agent depends on is malicious, compromised or tampered with.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Unexpected Code Execution
description: Code the agent generates or runs becomes a path to executing commands on the host or on internal systems.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Memory & Context Poisoning
description: Information the agent stores, retrieves or reuses is corrupted, so its behaviour stays wrong after the first interaction.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
description: Messages between agents are intercepted, spoofed or altered, because the channel between them is not authenticated.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Cascading Failures
description: One fault spreads between autonomous agents and compounds, because each acts on the last one's output without a check.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
description: A fluent and confident answer persuades a person to take an action they would not have taken after checking it.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording

name: Rogue Agents
description: The agent departs from its intended function or authorised scope and acts harmfully or deceptively on its own.
gloss_source: This register's one-line summary, not OWASP's wording
